issues: The acceptance test suite fails: __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts throws 'TypeError: A dynamic import callback was invoked without --experimental-vm-modules' at the `await import('../../src/lib/receiptStore')` dynamic import used in the generated M5 test. This is the exact file generated by test_acceptance.py (TESTS_DIR = PROJECT_ROOT / ' __tests__' / 'acceptance', note the leading space creating a duplicate ' __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts' alongside '__tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts'), so this failure is produced by the project's own acceptance runner, not an environment/tooling issue to dismiss. jest.config.js sets `nodeOptions: '--experimental-vm-modules'`, but Jest's config schema does not support a `nodeOptions` key (Jest logs 'Unknown option "nodeOptions"... probably a typing mistake' and ignores it), so the flag never reaches the Jest worker processes and dynamic import() fails. package.json's test script does pass `node --experimental-vm-modules` when running `npm test` directly, but test_acceptance.py invokes `npx jest --ci` (not `npm test`), so the flag is not applied when jest is invoked that way, and the jest.config.js nodeOptions workaround does not work either. Fix by making dynamic import work under however jest is actually invoked (e.g. use a static `import { addReceipt, getAllReceipts } from '../../src/lib/receiptStore'` in the relevant test files instead of dynamic import, since dynamic import isn't needed there at all), or otherwise ensure --experimental-vm-modules is honored by the actual invocation path used by test_acceptance.py. Both the duplicate ' __tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts' and '__tests__/acceptance/m5.test.ts' files fail the same way and must be fixed.
feedback: Two of 19 test suites fail as shown in the acceptance_test_result (m5.test.ts, both the space-prefixed and normal copies), caused by a dynamic import() of receiptStore inside an async test combined with jest.config.js's non-functional 'nodeOptions' setting. Since package.json's npm test script prepends the Node flag but test_acceptance.py calls `npx jest` directly, the flag isn't present during the actual graded run, so dynamic import fails every time. Please remove the dynamic import()s from m5 test content (static imports work fine there since addReceipt/getAllReceipts don't need to be loaded lazily) or otherwise fix module loading so the acceptance run (`npx jest --ci` as invoked by test_acceptance.py) passes without relying on an unsupported jest.config.js option.
